setup: G=$RUN/notes-good && cp -r "$SETUP/notes-broken" "$G" && python3 -c 'import json,sys; p=sys.argv[1]; d=json.load(open(p)); d["capabilities"].pop("storage"); json.dump(d, open(p,"w"), indent=2)' "$G/app.json" && $SLOP store new notes-app >/dev/null && $SLOP push "$G" --store notes-app >/dev/null && $SLOP store new notes --app notes-app >/dev/null && $SLOP grant set notes @member interact >/dev/null && $SLOP mount set "apps.localhost:$PORT" /notes notes >/dev/null && rm -rf "$G" && $SLOP push "$SETUP/notes-broken" --store notes-app >/dev/null
opening: Our notes app at /notes has been showing a blank page since yesterday's change. Can you fix it?
goal: the notes app at /notes works again
checklist: it finds the cause from the server (slop app status shows the manifest error)
the store is no longer broken and the page answers
it explains the cause in plain words
facts: app.json declares an unknown capability "storage"; slop app status notes shows broken: app.json: capabilities: unknown capability "storage".
slop push accepts a broken manifest; the error shows only at activation.
The store was mounted while the app was good; yesterday's push added "storage". A mount set on the broken app would answer the misleading 'notes is plain content: mount it on a static host'.
personaKnows: Someone added 'storage' to the app config yesterday because they thought it was needed for saving notes.
